profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer at Ping Identity | Experienced in Node, Java, C++, React
profile.summary:
Software developer that has a passion for seeing companies improving society through well-crafted software. I have a particular passion for scalable systems, backend software, and improving healthcare.  I enjoy learning new skills and helping others.

Back-End: Java + Spring, Node.js + Express
Web: React, JavaScript, AngularJS, TypeScript, jQuery, Python, PHP
Mobile: Android Java, Swift/Objective-C
Databases: Cassandra, MySQL, MongoDB, ElasticSearch
Cloud: Amazon AWS: EC2, Elastic Beanstalk, S3, SES, SNS, DigitalOcean, Docker, Kubernetes
Source Control: Git
Server Admin: Linux (Ubuntu), Nginx, Apache
Teamwork: Project leadership, Team Leadership, code reviews, advocacy
